# {{ page.title }} <i style="float: right;" class="g72-swoosh"></i>

###### Last Updated: 03/05/2021

###### Tags: {{ page.tag }}

---

Need the Nike Engineering Team to implement a new feature or have an idea for a feature improvement? Here is how you can turn that idea into a reality.

## Prerequisites

Once you have formulated your idea, think about how it benefits the customer and where it fits into Nike's business priority list.

Determine when you need the feature implemented and any important milestones that must be hit along the way.

You will also need to dedicate a point person from your team who can be available throughout the development, testing, and release process.

## Make a feature request

1. With the information you gathered in the prerequisite phase, click the **Create Intake Request** button at the end of this section. 
   
2. In the **Summary** field, insert "Intake Request: " + your team name.
   
3. Provide the following information in the **Description** field:
- Description of your idea or feature improvement
- Explanation of how your request benefits Nike's customers and fits into Nike's business priorities
- Technical Requirements of your request
- Your team's contact information
- List of key stakeholders
- Requested completion date
- Testing requirements
- Success criteria

When you submit the ticket, it creates a new Intake ticket in the Nike Engineering Team project.

<button class="green-button" type="button" id="submit-intake">Create Intake Request</button>

## Attend a grooming session

Attend a grooming session to provide more details about your feature request. Our team holds these sessions twice a week. If your idea is given the green light, our team will prioritize the work and put it on the development schedule.
